name: command-center-hud
title: Command Center HUD
description: Cyberpunk operational network operations center (NOC) HUD with six synchronized telemetry widgets.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Noc Multi Tile Monitoring: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
